history.11.src: Lake Trans Ltd. is established as the Group's logistics arm. The same year, DRC Petroleum S.A.R.L. is founded in the Democratic Republic of Congo and Lake Petroleum Ltd. is incorporated in Zambia  the Group's first ventures beyond Tanzania.
history.11.dst: Lake Trans Ltd. é estabelecida como braço logístico do Grupo. No mesmo ano, DRC Petroleum S.A.R.L. é fundada na República Democrática do Congo e a Lake Petroleum Ltd. é incorporada em Zambia os primeiros empreendimentos do Grupo além de Tanzania.

history.15.src: Burundi Petroleum opens its first petrol station in Burundi, and Lake Petroleum Rwanda  established in Kigali in 2011  begins importing and distributing fuel across Rwanda.
history.15.dst: Burundi Petroleum abre seu primeiro posto de gasolina em Burundi, e a Lake Petroleum Rwanda estabelecida em Kigali em 2011 começa a importar e distribuir combustível em Rwanda.

history.17.src: Lake Lubes Ltd. is established in Dar es Salaam to blend and market the Group's own lubricants, and Lake Gas launches Africa's first composite LPG cylinders  non-explosive, lightweight and translucent.
history.17.dst: Lake Lubes Ltd. é estabelecida em Dar es Salaam para misturar e comercializar os lubrificantes próprios do Grupo, e Lake Gas lança os primeiros cilindros compostos LPG de África não explosivos, leves e translúcidos.

history.19.src: The Competition Authority of Kenya approves Lake Oil's acquisition of Hashi Energy's Kenyan fuel-station network  a landmark step into East Africa's largest retail fuel market.
history.19.dst: A Autoridade da Concorrência de Kenya aprova a aquisição pela Lake Oil da rede de postos de combustível Kenyan da Hashi Energy, um passo marcante no maior mercado retalhista de combustíveis de East Africa.

history.21.src: Lake Gas invests in Tanga, commissioning what opens as East Africa's largest LPG storage terminal  1,000 MT of capacity, receiving ships through a dedicated single point mooring buoy.
history.21.dst: Lake Gas investe em Tanga, comissionando o que é inaugurado como o maior terminal de armazenamento LPG de East Africa, com capacidade de 1.000 toneladas, recebendo navios por meio de uma bóia de amarração de ponto único dedicada.

history.23.src: Lake Steel and Allied Products starts operations at Visiga, Kibaha  the first producer of high-strength, corrosion-resistant (HS-CR) rebar in Tanzania, with an annual capacity of 100,000 metric tonnes.
history.23.dst: Lake Steel e Allied Products iniciam operações em Visiga, Kibaha, o primeiro produtor de vergalhões de alta resistência e resistentes à corrosão (HS-CR) em Tanzania, com capacidade anual de 100.000 toneladas métricas.

leadership.110.src: Born in 1980 into a family of traders, Awadh studied Business Administration at Brock University in Canada - supporting himself with odd jobs while building early trading instincts. By his mid-20s he had already moved into truck refurbishing and commodity trading. In 2006 he launched Lake Oil; official Group materials place him at 27 at founding.
leadership.110.dst: Nascido em 1980 em uma família de traders, Awadh estudou Administração de Empresas na Universidade Brock, no Canadá – sustentando-se com biscates enquanto desenvolvia instintos comerciais precoces. Por volta dos 20 anos, ele já havia se dedicado à reforma de caminhões e ao comércio de commodities. Em 2006 lançou Lake Oil; os materiais oficiais do Grupo o colocam aos 27 anos na fundação.

leadership.111.src: His oversight today spans oil marketing, supply chain, downstream logistics and heavy industrial manufacturing across Tanzania, Kenya, Zambia, DR Congo, Burundi and Rwanda - with wider Group presence also in Ethiopia, Mozambique and Dubai (MERM). Under his chairmanship the Group has grown retail networks (152 stations), storage infrastructure, a 1,200+ truck fleet, LPG terminals, Lake Steel, ready-mix concrete and AFICD port-extension services.
leadership.111.dst: A sua supervisão hoje abrange o marketing de petróleo, a cadeia de abastecimento, a logística a jusante e a produção industrial pesada em Tanzania, Kenya, Zambia, RD Congo, Burundi e Rwanda - com uma presença mais ampla do Grupo também na Etiópia, Mozambique e Dubai (MERM). Sob sua presidência, o Grupo expandiu redes de varejo (152 estações), infraestrutura de armazenamento, uma frota de mais de 1.200 caminhões, LPG terminais, Lake Steel, concreto pronto e AFICD serviços de extensão portuária.

leadership.112.src: In 2017 Forbes covered Lake Oil Group’s regional push - including Competition Authority of Kenya approval to acquire Hashi Energy’s Kenyan station network - and described the enterprise as a billion-dollar (revenue) integrated energy platform. Awadh has also been recognised by African Leadership Magazine (Young Business Leader of the Year, 2022) and as Young African Energy Leader of the Year (African Business Leadership Awards, 2023).
leadership.112.dst: Em 2017, a Forbes cobriu o impulso regional de Lake Oil Group - ​​incluindo a aprovação da Autoridade da Concorrência de Kenya para adquirir a rede de estações Kenyan da Hashi Energy - e descreveu a empresa como uma plataforma de energia integrada de bilhões de dólares (receitas). Awadh também foi reconhecido pela African Leadership Magazine (Jovem Líder Empresarial do Ano, 2022) e como Jovem Líder Energético Africano do Ano (Prémios de Liderança Empresarial Africana, 2023).

leadership.117.src: As Manufacturing CEO, Dilip Kumar’s mandate sits at the industrial heart of the Group’s diversification beyond petroleum. Lake Steel operates a computerized automatic rolling mill at Visiga, Kibaha (Plot 118, Block M), with throughput up to about 25 tonnes/hour and annual capacity around 100,000 MT - with publicly discussed expansion toward 150,000 MT.

Lake Steel opera um laminador automático computadorizado em Visiga, Kibaha (Lote 118, Bloco M), com produção de até cerca de 25 toneladas/hora e capacidade anual de cerca de 100.000 toneladas métricas - com expansão discutida publicamente para 150.000 toneladas métricas.

leadership.118.src: The mill introduced high-strength corrosion-resistant (HS-CR) rebar to Tanzania, engineered to retain strength at elevated temperatures and deliver markedly higher corrosion resistance than ordinary rebar.
leadership.118.dst: A fábrica introduziu vergalhões de alta resistência e resistentes à corrosão (HS-CR) em Tanzania, projetados para reter a resistência em temperaturas elevadas e oferecer resistência à corrosão significativamente maior do que os vergalhões comuns.

leadership.141.src: As Director of Operations, Juma Nuru is responsible for aligning day-to-day execution across Lake Group’s operating companies so energy, logistics and industrial units deliver reliably against Group standards.
leadership.141.dst: Como Diretor de Operações, Juma Nuru é responsável por alinhar a execução diária em todas as empresas operacionais do Lake Group para que as unidades de energia, logística e industriais forneçam resultados confiáveis ​​de acordo com os padrões do Grupo.

leadership.142.src: As the Director of Operations, one of my key responsibilities is to ensure that all operations are executed efficiently and without disruption. This includes maintaining strong coordination between the operations team and management, so that everything runs seamlessly and in alignment with our goals.
leadership.142.dst: Como Diretor de Operações, uma das minhas principais responsabilidades é garantir que todas as operações sejam executadas de forma eficiente e sem interrupções. Isto inclui manter uma forte coordenação entre a equipa de operações e a gestão, para que tudo corra perfeitamente e em alinhamento com os nossos objetivos.

leadership.143.src: The role spans operational performance, coordination between business units, and continuous improvement of processes that keep depots, fleets, plants and commercial teams running as one organisation. Working through Group HQ in Dar es Salaam, the operations desk supports country and unit leadership with clear priorities, escalation paths and performance visibility.
leadership.143.dst: A função abrange desempenho operacional, coordenação entre unidades de negócios e melhoria contínua de processos que mantêm depósitos, frotas, fábricas e equipes comerciais funcionando como uma única organização. agro.hero.lede.src: Creating customers and food for life through plantations, integrated Ag Parks and agribusiness processing across Africa.
agro.hero.lede.dst: Criar clientes e alimentos para a vida através de plantações, parques agrícolas integrados e processamento de agronegócios em toda a África.

agro.s1.lede.src: Private business communities partnering with governments, development financial institutions (DFIs) and initiatives like the Africa Savannahs Initiative to assist Africa to feed itself and create jobs for youth and women.
agro.s1.lede.dst: Comunidades empresariais privadas em parceria com governos, instituições financeiras de desenvolvimento (IFD) e iniciativas como a Iniciativa das Savanas Africanas para ajudar África a alimentar-se e a criar empregos para jovens e mulheres.

agro.s1.p2.src: At least 233 million people were estimated to be hungry or undernourished in sub-Saharan Africa (UN FAO, 2014). Africa’s food challenge is compounded by a population expected to double to 2.4 billion by 2050.
agro.s1.p2.dst: Estima-se que pelo menos 233 milhões de pessoas passem fome ou subnutridas na África Subsariana (ONU FAO, 2014). O desafio alimentar de África é agravado por uma população que se espera duplicar para 2,4 mil milhões até 2050.

agro.s1.p3.src: Africa’s Agriculture Status Report 2017 (Alliance for a Green Revolution in Africa) notes the continent’s food market is growing rapidly, with opportunities estimated at more than $1 trillion every year by 2030, helping substitute food imports with high-value food made in Africa.
agro.s1.p3.dst: O Relatório sobre a Situação da Agricultura em África de 2017 (Aliança para uma Revolução Verde em África) observa que o mercado alimentar do continente está a crescer rapidamente, com oportunidades estimadas em mais de 1 bilião de dólares por ano até 2030, ajudando a substituir as importações de alimentos por alimentos de alto valor produzidos em África.

agro.s2.lede.src: We secure, establish and consolidate farm platforms via greenfield projects or existing farm acquisitions in selected markets within our network of countries where economies of scale can be achieved.
agro.s2.lede.dst: Garantimos, estabelecemos e consolidamos plataformas agrícolas através de projetos greenfield ou aquisições agrícolas existentes em mercados selecionados dentro da nossa rede de países onde podem ser alcançadas economias de escala.

agro.card.land.body.src: Underutilized, cost-effective land with mineralized, diversified soils along water basins and catchments whose mass exceeds farmed land to ensure water perennity over 20 years.
agro.card.land.body.dst: Terras subutilizadas e rentáveis, com solos mineralizados e diversificados ao longo de bacias hidrográficas e bacias hidrográficas cuja massa excede as terras cultivadas para garantir a perenidade da água ao longo de 20 anos.

agro.card.access.body.src: Countries connected by rail and established transport corridors for accessible set-up or distribution of final produce within country or for export.
agro.card.access.body.dst: Países ligados por caminho-de-ferro e corredores de transporte estabelecidos para instalação acessível ou distribuição de produtos finais dentro do país ou para exportação.

agro.card.prox.body.src: Multiple continental export hubs across the network region, including major South East and Asia-facing ports and Atlantic hub access in Namibia.
agro.card.prox.body.dst: Vários centros de exportação continentais em toda a região da rede, incluindo os principais portos voltados para o Sudeste e para a Ásia e acesso ao centro do Atlântico na Namíbia.

agro.card.tech.body.src: Established technical capability in-country for ag technology transfer and adequate management of farms and Integrated Ag Parks.
agro.card.tech.body.dst: Capacidade técnica estabelecida no país para transferência de tecnologia agrícola e gestão adequada de fazendas e parques agrícolas integrados.

agro.card.capital.body.src: International funding, local ag funding, specialist or development banks, and African institutional funding to bridge food-security needs.
agro.card.capital.body.dst: Financiamento internacional, financiamento agrícola local, bancos especializados ou de desenvolvimento e financiamento institucional africano para colmatar as necessidades de segurança alimentar.

agro.card.group.body.src: Central Lake Group functions (IT, legal, audit, finance, treasury, HR) support Lake Agro operations and growth plans.
agro.card.group.body.dst: As funções centrais Lake Group (TI, jurídico, auditoria, finanças, tesouraria, RH) apoiam Lake Agro operações e planos de crescimento.

agro.s3.prep.body.src: Deploy Phase 1 growth; rapid turnaround of underperforming Phase 2 acquisitions; lift yields and land development on greenfield plantation farms.
agro.s3.prep.body.dst: Implantar o crescimento da Fase 1; rápida recuperação de aquisições de Fase 2 com baixo desempenho; aumentar os rendimentos e o desenvolvimento da terra em fazendas de plantações greenfield.

agro.s3.plan.body.src: Add Integrated Ag Parks in Phase 1 for consolidation and value addition; select and acquire Phase 2 market-entry farms.
agro.s3.plan.body.dst: Adicionar Parques Agrícolas Integrados na Fase 1 para consolidação e agregação de valor; selecionar e adquirir fazendas de entrada no mercado da Fase 2.

agro.s3.process.body.src: Stand up processing as Phase 1 farms stabilize; reorganize value-addition facilities to accommodate Integrated Ag Parks in Phase 2.
agro.s3.process.body.dst: Processamento permanente à medida que as fazendas da Fase 1 se estabilizam; reorganizar instalações de valor agregado para acomodar Parques Agrícolas Integrados na Fase 2.

agro.s3.yields.src: Target average yields above 11 t/ha of arable land across commoditized crops including wheat, soybean, maize, rice, sunflower, sugar and protein (beef), with rotational diversification into teak, beans and horticulture (fruit) where land permits.
agro.s3.yields.dst: Meta de rendimentos médios acima de 11 t/ha de terras aráveis ​​em culturas comoditizadas, incluindo trigo, soja, milho, arroz, girassol, açúcar e proteínas (carne bovina), com diversificação rotativa em teca, feijão e horticultura (frutas) onde a terra permitir.

agro.s4.grains.body.src: Wheat, maize, rice, soybean and sunflower platforms for regional food security and processing feedstocks.
agro.s4.grains.body.dst: Plataformas de trigo, milho, arroz, soja e girassol para segurança alimentar regional e matérias-primas de processamento.

agro.s4.sugar.body.src: Sugar and related cash crops as core processing feedstocks within the Ag Park model.
agro.s4.sugar.body.dst: Açúcar e culturas comerciais relacionadas como principais matérias-primas de processamento no modelo Ag Park.

agro.s4.protein.body.src: Beef protein plus teak, beans and fruit horticulture in buffer spaces where land permits.
agro.s4.protein.body.dst: Proteína bovina mais teca, feijão e horticultura de frutas em espaços tampão onde a terra permitir.

agro.s5.serenje.body.src: Operations oversee the Serenje plantation platform with specialties in agronomy, crop harvesting, disease control, seed/fertilizer/input management, equipment procurement, works contracting and irrigation project oversight.
agro.s5.serenje.body.dst: As operações supervisionam a plataforma de plantações de Serenje com especialidades em agronomia, colheita de culturas, controlo de doenças, gestão de sementes/fertilizantes/insumos, aquisição de equipamentos, contratação de obras e supervisão de projetos de irrigação.

agro.s5.parks.body.src: Ag Parks consolidate produce and add value through processing. As the first Ag Park team is constituted, capacity is expected to roughly double, supported by Rising Stars projects that attract and retain talent.
agro.s5.parks.body.dst: A Ag Parks consolida a produção e agrega valor por meio do processamento. À medida que a primeira equipa do Ag Park for constituída, espera-se que a capacidade praticamente duplique, apoiada por projetos Rising Stars que atraem e retêm talentos.

agro.s6.lede.src: People are Lake Agro’s biggest company asset. Farming does not exist without human capital and equity. About 60 roles oversee Serenje plantation and Tanzania regional offices, scaling as Ag Park teams form.
agro.s6.lede.dst: As pessoas são o maior ativo da empresa Lake Agro. A agricultura não existe sem capital humano e equidade. Cerca de 60 funções supervisionam a plantação de Serenje e os escritórios regionais Tanzania, aumentando à medida que as equipes do Ag Park se formam.

agro.s7.csr.body.src: Lake Group considers contribution to the community a high priority. We create local labour, train employees and improve professional know-how across operations.
agro.s7.csr.body.dst: Lake Group considera a contribuição para a comunidade uma alta prioridade. Criamos mão de obra local, treinamos funcionários e melhoramos o conhecimento profissional em todas as operações.

agro.s7.es.body.src: Projects follow high E/S standards, including IFC Performance Standards for new CAPEX. No people are harmed, resettled or lose land or property as a result of our activities. Dedicated teams ensure compliance on each project.
agro.s7.es.body.dst: Os projetos seguem elevados padrões ambientais e sociais, incluindo padrões de desempenho da IFC para novos CAPEX. Nenhuma pessoa é prejudicada, reassentada ou perde terras ou propriedades como resultado das nossas atividades. Equipes dedicadas garantem a conformidade em cada projeto.

agro.s8.p1.src: All departments (IT, legal counsel, auditing and human resources) are streamlined to help achieve future strategies. A talent pool of human resources allows Lake Agro to operate and maintain project sustainability financially, socially and on a production basis.
agro.s8.p1.dst: Todos os departamentos (TI, assessoria jurídica, auditoria e recursos humanos) são simplificados para ajudar a alcançar estratégias futuras. Um conjunto de talentos de recursos humanos permite que Lake Agro opere e mantenha a sustentabilidade do projeto financeiramente, socialmente e numa base produtiva.

agro.s8.p2.src: Leadership technical know-how entrenches a deep understanding of how to plan, run and execute plantations - and how to secure or improve them over time.
agro.s8.p2.dst: O conhecimento técnico da liderança consolida uma compreensão profunda de como planejar, administrar e executar plantações - e como protegê-las ou melhorá-las ao longo do tempo.

atl.s1.p2.src: With a focus on excellence, ATL has earned a reputation as a reliable name in trailer manufacturing, delivering tankers that consistently meet and surpass customer expectations. Our strategy expands the range into premium customized trailers across the region.
atl.s1.p2.dst: Com foco na excelência, ATL conquistou a reputação de ser um nome confiável na fabricação de reboques, fornecendo caminhões-tanque que atendem e superam consistentemente as expectativas dos clientes. Nossa estratégia expande a linha para reboques personalizados premium em toda a região.

atl.s1.check1.dst: Único fabricante de reboques de alumínio em Tanzania

atl.s2.mission.body.src: To design and manufacture the highest quality trailers by fostering a culture of integrity, excellence, and continuous improvement.

atl.s2.vision.body.src: To become the leading trailer manufacturer in East and Central Africa, providing sustainable solutions focused on safety, innovation and customization.
atl.s2.vision.body.dst: Tornar-se o fabricante líder de reboques no Oriente e Central Africa, fornecendo soluções sustentáveis ​​com foco em segurança, inovação e personalização.

atl.val.integrity.d.src: Honesty, transparency and accountability. We deliver on promises and maintain a strong moral compass.
atl.val.integrity.d.dst: Honestidade, transparência e responsabilidade. Cumprimos promessas e mantemos uma forte bússola moral.

atl.val.people.d.src: Employees are our greatest asset - safety, inclusion, professional development and a positive culture.
atl.val.people.d.dst: Os colaboradores são o nosso maior patrimônio – segurança, inclusão, desenvolvimento profissional e uma cultura positiva.

atl.val.sust.d.src: Lower impact materials and processes; products that support greener transport requirements.
atl.val.sust.d.dst: Materiais e processos de menor impacto; produtos que apoiem requisitos de transporte mais ecológicos.

atl.val.cust.d.src: Long-term partners built on trust, value, quality and reliability - not one-off sales.
atl.val.cust.d.dst: Parceiros de longo prazo baseados em confiança, valor, qualidade e confiabilidade – e não em vendas pontuais.

atl.s3.savings.4.src: Long-term savings on maintenance and repairs
atl.s3.savings.4.dst: Economia a longo prazo em manutenção e reparos

atl.s4.non.body.src: Aluminum is non-reactive with most fuels, helping prevent contamination - especially important for sensitive fuels including aviation fuel.
atl.s4.non.body.dst: O alumínio não é reativo com a maioria dos combustíveis, ajudando a prevenir a contaminação – especialmente importante para combustíveis sensíveis, incluindo combustível de aviação.

atl.s4.corr.body.src: Naturally resists rust in harsh weather and moisture, reducing maintenance and prolonging tanker life.
atl.s4.corr.body.dst: Resiste naturalmente à ferrugem em condições climáticas adversas e à umidade, reduzindo a manutenção e prolongando a vida útil do navio-tanque.

atl.s4.fuel.body.src: Lower tare weight means more legal payload and less energy to haul the tanker.
atl.s4.fuel.body.dst: Uma tara mais baixa significa mais carga útil legal e menos energia para transportar o navio-tanque.

atl.s4.str.body.src: High strength-to-weight ratio for transport stresses, with impact absorption that supports operational safety.
atl.s4.str.body.dst: Alta relação resistência-peso para tensões de transporte, com absorção de impacto que apoia a segurança operacional.

atl.s4.env.body.src: Highly recyclable aluminium with lower recycling energy versus primary production - aligned with strict fuel-transport standards.
atl.s4.env.body.dst: Alumínio altamente reciclável com menor energia de reciclagem em comparação com a produção primária - alinhado com rigorosos padrões de transporte de combustível.

atl.s4.custom.body.src: Expanding beyond fuel tankers into premium customized trailers for regional logistics needs.
atl.s4.custom.body.dst: Expandindo além dos tanques de combustível para reboques premium personalizados para necessidades de logística regional.

atl.s6.lede.src: At ATL, we pride ourselves on trailers that deliver unmatched performance, durability, and value. Hear from the people who rely on our aluminum trailers every day.

atl.s6.q1.src: "Thank you, Aluminum Trailers Limited. Looking forward for more transformation of our trailers with you. As you won't find a better customer servicing of high quality manufacturing anywhere else in East Africa, it just allows us to rely on you comfortably."

history.7.src: A story of bold decisions, relentless expansion, and building an energy empire from the ground up.
history.7.dst: Una historia de decisiones audaces, expansión implacable y construcción de un imperio energético desde cero.

history.9.src: Ally Edha Awadh founds Lake Oil Ltd. at age 27 in Dar es Salaam, Tanzania, the seed of what would become Lake Group. Begins petroleum distribution with a small fleet.
history.9.dst: Ally Edha Awadh funda Lake Oil Ltd. a los 27 años en Dar es Salaam, Tanzania, la semilla de lo que se convertiría en Lake Group. Comienza la distribución de petróleo con una pequeña flota.

history.11.src: Lake Trans Ltd. is established as the Group's logistics arm. The same year, DRC Petroleum S.A.R.L. is founded in the Democratic Republic of Congo and Lake Petroleum Ltd. is incorporated in Zambia  the Group's first ventures beyond Tanzania.
history.11.dst: Lake Trans Ltd. se establece como el brazo logístico del Grupo. El mismo año, DRC Petroleum S.A.R.L. se funda en la República Democrática del Congo y Lake Petroleum Ltd. se incorpora en Zambia, las primeras empresas del Grupo más allá de Tanzania.

history.13.src: Gulf Concrete and Cement Products Company (GCCP) is established, quickly becoming the market leader in ready-mix concrete supply in Dar es Salaam.
history.13.dst: Se establece Gulf Concrete and Cement Products Company (GCCP), convirtiéndose rápidamente en el líder del mercado en el suministro de concreto premezclado en Dar es Salaam.

history.15.src: Burundi Petroleum opens its first petrol station in Burundi, and Lake Petroleum Rwanda  established in Kigali in 2011  begins importing and distributing fuel across Rwanda.
history.15.dst: Burundi Petroleum abre su primera gasolinera en Burundi, y Lake Petroleum Rwanda, establecida en Kigali en 2011, comienza a importar y distribuir combustible en Rwanda.

history.17.src: Lake Lubes Ltd. is established in Dar es Salaam to blend and market the Group's own lubricants, and Lake Gas launches Africa's first composite LPG cylinders  non-explosive, lightweight and translucent.
history.17.dst: Lake Lubes Ltd. se establece en Dar es Salaam para mezclar y comercializar los lubricantes propios del Grupo, y Lake Gas lanza los primeros cilindros compuestos LPG de África, no explosivos, livianos y translúcidos.

history.19.src: The Competition Authority of Kenya approves Lake Oil's acquisition of Hashi Energy's Kenyan fuel-station network  a landmark step into East Africa's largest retail fuel market.
history.19.dst: La Autoridad de Competencia de Kenya aprueba la adquisición por parte de Lake Oil de la red de estaciones de combustible Kenyan de Hashi Energy, un paso histórico hacia el mercado minorista de combustible más grande de East Africa.

history.21.src: Lake Gas invests in Tanga, commissioning what opens as East Africa's largest LPG storage terminal  1,000 MT of capacity, receiving ships through a dedicated single point mooring buoy.
history.21.dst: Lake Gas invierte en Tanga, poniendo en marcha lo que se abre como la terminal de almacenamiento LPG más grande de East Africa, con 1.000 toneladas de capacidad, que recibe barcos a través de una boya de amarre de un solo punto.

history.23.src: Lake Steel and Allied Products starts operations at Visiga, Kibaha  the first producer of high-strength, corrosion-resistant (HS-CR) rebar in Tanzania, with an annual capacity of 100,000 metric tonnes.
history.23.dst: Lake Steel y Allied Products inician operaciones en Visiga, Kibaha, el primer productor de barras de refuerzo de alta resistencia y resistentes a la corrosión (HS-CR) en Tanzania, con una capacidad anual de 100.000 toneladas métricas.

history.25.src: The Tanga LPG terminal is expanded to 3,000 MT, and founder Ally Edha Awadh is named Young Business Leader of the Year by the African Leadership Magazine.
history.25.dst: La terminal Tanga LPG se amplía a 3000 toneladas y la fundadora, Ally Edha Awadh, es nombrada Líder Empresarial Joven del Año por la revista African Leadership.

sustainability.8.src: Our sustainability strategy covers environmental stewardship, clean cooking energy access, land reclamation, waste management and progressive decarbonisation of our logistics fleet.

sustainability.9.src: LPG, a core business of Lake Gas, plays a critical role in East Africa's clean cooking agenda, reducing dependence on charcoal and firewood, improving indoor air quality and reducing deforestation.
sustainability.9.dst: LPG, un negocio principal de Lake Gas, desempeña un papel fundamental en la agenda de cocina limpia de East Africa, reduciendo la dependencia del carbón y la leña, mejorando la calidad del aire interior y reduciendo la deforestación.

sustainability.13.src: Lake Gas supplies LPG across 6 countries, helping households switch from charcoal to cleaner cooking. Every cylinder sold reduces CO₂, indoor air pollution and deforestation pressure.
sustainability.13.dst: Lake Gas suministra a LPG en 6 países, ayudando a los hogares a pasar del carbón a una cocina más limpia. Cada cilindro vendido reduce el CO₂, la contaminación del aire interior y la presión de la deforestación.

sustainability.15.src: Petroleum transport operations are run with a zero-spillage ambition. Tankers are regularly inspected and maintained at the Group's own workshops in Kibaha, Kigamboni and Morogoro.
sustainability.15.dst: Las operaciones de transporte de petróleo se llevan a cabo con la ambición de evitar derrames. Los petroleros son inspeccionados y mantenidos periódicamente en los propios talleres del Grupo en Kibaha, Kigamboni y Morogoro.

sustainability.17.src: GCCP's quarry at Lugoba supplies aggregate for the Group's concrete operations. We are committed to responsible extraction and to progressively rehabilitating worked-out areas.
sustainability.17.dst: La cantera de GCCP en Lugoba suministra áridos para las operaciones de hormigón del Grupo. Apostamos por la extracción responsable y por la rehabilitación progresiva de las zonas explotadas.

sustainability.19.src: Ongoing investment in newer, fuel-efficient trucks, reducing per-kilometre emissions across our 1,200+ vehicle fleet while improving service reliability.
sustainability.19.dst: Inversión continua en camiones más nuevos y de bajo consumo de combustible, lo que reduce las emisiones por kilómetro en nuestra flota de más de 1200 vehículos y, al mismo tiempo, mejora la confiabilidad del servicio.

leadership.110.src: Born in 1980 into a family of traders, Awadh studied Business Administration at Brock University in Canada - supporting himself with odd jobs while building early trading instincts. By his mid-20s he had already moved into truck refurbishing and commodity trading. In 2006 he launched Lake Oil; official Group materials place him at 27 at founding.
leadership.110.dst: Nacido en 1980 en una familia de comerciantes, Awadh estudió Administración de Empresas en la Universidad de Brock en Canadá, manteniéndose con trabajos ocasionales mientras desarrollaba sus primeros instintos comerciales. Cuando tenía veintitantos años, ya se había dedicado a la restauración de camiones y al comercio de productos básicos. En 2006 lanzó Lake Oil; Los materiales oficiales del Grupo lo ubican en 27 años en el momento de su fundación.

leadership.111.src: His oversight today spans oil marketing, supply chain, downstream logistics and heavy industrial manufacturing across Tanzania, Kenya, Zambia, DR Congo, Burundi and Rwanda - with wider Group presence also in Ethiopia, Mozambique and Dubai (MERM). Under his chairmanship the Group has grown retail networks (152 stations), storage infrastructure, a 1,200+ truck fleet, LPG terminals, Lake Steel, ready-mix concrete and AFICD port-extension services.
leadership.111.dst: Su supervisión hoy abarca el marketing de petróleo, la cadena de suministro, la logística downstream y la fabricación industrial pesada en Tanzania, Kenya, Zambia, la República Democrática del Congo, Burundi y Rwanda, con una presencia más amplia del Grupo también en Etiopía, Mozambique y Dubai (MERM). Bajo su presidencia, el Grupo ha ampliado sus redes minoristas (152 estaciones), infraestructura de almacenamiento, una flota de más de 1200 camiones, terminales LPG, Lake Steel, concreto premezclado y servicios de extensión portuaria AFICD.

leadership.112.src: In 2017 Forbes covered Lake Oil Group’s regional push - including Competition Authority of Kenya approval to acquire Hashi Energy’s Kenyan station network - and described the enterprise as a billion-dollar (revenue) integrated energy platform. Awadh has also been recognised by African Leadership Magazine (Young Business Leader of the Year, 2022) and as Young African Energy Leader of the Year (African Business Leadership Awards, 2023).
leadership.112.dst: En 2017, Forbes cubrió el impulso regional de Lake Oil Group, incluida la aprobación de la Autoridad de Competencia de Kenya para adquirir la red de estaciones Kenyan de Hashi Energy, y describió la empresa como una plataforma energética integrada de mil millones de dólares (ingresos). Awadh también ha sido reconocido por la revista African Leadership (Joven líder empresarial del año, 2022) y como Joven líder africano en energía del año (African Business Leadership Awards, 2023).

leadership.117.src: As Manufacturing CEO, Dilip Kumar’s mandate sits at the industrial heart of the Group’s diversification beyond petroleum. Lake Steel operates a computerized automatic rolling mill at Visiga, Kibaha (Plot 118, Block M), with throughput up to about 25 tonnes/hour and annual capacity around 100,000 MT - with publicly discussed expansion toward 150,000 MT.
leadership.117.dst: Como Fabricación CEO, el mandato de Dilip Kumar se sitúa en el corazón industrial de la diversificación del Grupo más allá del petróleo. Lake Steel opera un laminador automático computarizado en Visiga, Kibaha (Lote 118, Bloque M), con un rendimiento de hasta aproximadamente 25 toneladas/hora y una capacidad anual de alrededor de 100 000 TM, con una expansión discutida públicamente hacia 150 000 TM.

leadership.118.src: The mill introduced high-strength corrosion-resistant (HS-CR) rebar to Tanzania, engineered to retain strength at elevated temperatures and deliver markedly higher corrosion resistance than ordinary rebar.
leadership.118.dst: La fábrica introdujo barras de refuerzo resistentes a la corrosión (HS-CR) de alta resistencia a Tanzania, diseñadas para retener la resistencia a temperaturas elevadas y ofrecer una resistencia a la corrosión notablemente mayor que las barras de refuerzo ordinarias.

leadership.119.src: His portfolio also connects to the Group’s construction-materials chain: Gulf Aggregates crushing plants, Lake Premix / GCCP ready-mix operations in Dar es Salaam, and the wider building-products ecosystem that supplies contractors and infrastructure projects.
leadership.119.dst: Su cartera también se conecta con la cadena de materiales de construcción del Grupo: Gulf Aggregates plantas de trituración, operaciones de premezclado de Lake Premix/GCCP en Dar es Salaam y el ecosistema más amplio de productos de construcción que suministra a contratistas y proyectos de infraestructura.

leadership.141.src: As Director of Operations, Juma Nuru is responsible for aligning day-to-day execution across Lake Group’s operating companies so energy, logistics and industrial units deliver reliably against Group standards.
leadership.141.dst: Como Director de Operaciones, Juma Nuru es responsable de alinear la ejecución diaria en las empresas operativas de Lake Group para que las unidades industriales, de energía y de logística cumplan de manera confiable con los estándares del Grupo.

leadership.142.src: As the Director of Operations, one of my key responsibilities is to ensure that all operations are executed efficiently and without disruption. This includes maintaining strong coordination between the operations team and management, so that everything runs seamlessly and in alignment with our goals.
leadership.142.dst: Como Director de Operaciones, una de mis responsabilidades clave es garantizar que todas las operaciones se ejecuten de manera eficiente y sin interrupciones. Esto incluye mantener una fuerte coordinación entre el equipo de operaciones y la gerencia, para que todo funcione sin problemas y alineado con nuestros objetivos.

agro.s1.lede.dst: Comunidades empresariales privadas que se asocian con gobiernos, instituciones financieras de desarrollo (DFI) e iniciativas como la Iniciativa Africa Savannahs para ayudar a África a alimentarse y crear empleos para jóvenes y mujeres.

agro.s1.p2.src: At least 233 million people were estimated to be hungry or undernourished in sub-Saharan Africa (UN FAO, 2014). Africa’s food challenge is compounded by a population expected to double to 2.4 billion by 2050.
agro.s1.p2.dst: Se estima que al menos 233 millones de personas padecen hambre o están desnutridas en el África subsahariana (ONU FAO, 2014). El desafío alimentario de África se ve agravado por una población que se espera que se duplique a 2.400 millones para 2050.

agro.s1.p3.src: Africa’s Agriculture Status Report 2017 (Alliance for a Green Revolution in Africa) notes the continent’s food market is growing rapidly, with opportunities estimated at more than $1 trillion every year by 2030, helping substitute food imports with high-value food made in Africa.
agro.s1.p3.dst: El Informe sobre la situación de la agricultura en África 2017 (Alianza para una Revolución Verde en África) señala que el mercado de alimentos del continente está creciendo rápidamente, con oportunidades estimadas en más de $1 billón cada año para 2030, lo que ayudará a sustituir las importaciones de alimentos con alimentos de alto valor fabricados en África.

agro.s2.lede.src: We secure, establish and consolidate farm platforms via greenfield projects or existing farm acquisitions in selected markets within our network of countries where economies of scale can be achieved.
agro.s2.lede.dst: Aseguramos, establecemos y consolidamos plataformas agrícolas a través de proyectos totalmente nuevos o adquisiciones de granjas existentes en mercados seleccionados dentro de nuestra red de países donde se pueden lograr economías de escala.

agro.card.land.body.src: Underutilized, cost-effective land with mineralized, diversified soils along water basins and catchments whose mass exceeds farmed land to ensure water perennity over 20 years.
agro.card.land.body.dst: Tierras subutilizadas y rentables con suelos mineralizados y diversificados a lo largo de cuencas y captaciones de agua cuya masa excede la tierra cultivada para garantizar la perennidad del agua durante 20 años.

agro.card.access.body.src: Countries connected by rail and established transport corridors for accessible set-up or distribution of final produce within country or for export.
agro.card.access.body.dst: Países conectados por ferrocarril y corredores de transporte establecidos para el establecimiento o distribución accesible de productos finales dentro del país o para exportación.

agro.card.prox.body.src: Multiple continental export hubs across the network region, including major South East and Asia-facing ports and Atlantic hub access in Namibia.
agro.card.prox.body.dst: Múltiples centros de exportación continentales en toda la región de la red, incluidos los principales puertos orientados al sudeste y Asia y el acceso al centro del Atlántico en Namibia.

agro.card.tech.body.src: Established technical capability in-country for ag technology transfer and adequate management of farms and Integrated Ag Parks.
agro.card.tech.body.dst: Capacidad técnica establecida en el país para la transferencia de tecnología agrícola y la gestión adecuada de granjas y parques agrícolas integrados.

agro.card.capital.body.src: International funding, local ag funding, specialist or development banks, and African institutional funding to bridge food-security needs.
agro.card.capital.body.dst: Financiamiento internacional, financiamiento agrícola local, bancos especializados o de desarrollo y financiamiento institucional africano para cubrir las necesidades de seguridad alimentaria.

agro.card.group.body.src: Central Lake Group functions (IT, legal, audit, finance, treasury, HR) support Lake Agro operations and growth plans.
agro.card.group.body.dst: Las funciones centrales de Lake Group (TI, legal, auditoría, finanzas, tesorería, recursos humanos) respaldan las operaciones de Lake Agro y los planes de crecimiento.

agro.s3.prep.body.src: Deploy Phase 1 growth; rapid turnaround of underperforming Phase 2 acquisitions; lift yields and land development on greenfield plantation farms.
agro.s3.prep.body.dst: Implementar el crecimiento de la Fase 1; rápida recuperación de adquisiciones de bajo rendimiento en la Fase 2; aumentar los rendimientos y el desarrollo de la tierra en granjas de plantaciones totalmente nuevas.

agro.s3.plan.body.src: Add Integrated Ag Parks in Phase 1 for consolidation and value addition; select and acquire Phase 2 market-entry farms.
agro.s3.plan.body.dst: Agregar parques agrícolas integrados en la Fase 1 para consolidación y adición de valor; seleccionar y adquirir granjas de entrada al mercado de la Fase 2.

agro.s3.process.body.src: Stand up processing as Phase 1 farms stabilize; reorganize value-addition facilities to accommodate Integrated Ag Parks in Phase 2.
agro.s3.process.body.dst: Poner en marcha el procesamiento a medida que se estabilizan las granjas de la Fase 1; reorganizar las instalaciones de valor agregado para acomodar los Parques Agrícolas Integrados en la Fase 2.

agro.s3.yields.src: Target average yields above 11 t/ha of arable land across commoditized crops including wheat, soybean, maize, rice, sunflower, sugar and protein (beef), with rotational diversification into teak, beans and horticulture (fruit) where land permits.
agro.s3.yields.dst: Apuntar a rendimientos promedio superiores a 11 t/ha de tierra cultivable en cultivos mercantilizados, incluidos trigo, soja, maíz, arroz, girasol, azúcar y proteínas (carne de res), con diversificación rotacional hacia teca, frijoles y horticultura (frutas) cuando la tierra lo permita.

agro.s4.grains.body.src: Wheat, maize, rice, soybean and sunflower platforms for regional food security and processing feedstocks.
agro.s4.grains.body.dst: Plataformas de trigo, maíz, arroz, soja y girasol para la seguridad alimentaria regional y el procesamiento de materias primas.

agro.s4.sugar.body.src: Sugar and related cash crops as core processing feedstocks within the Ag Park model.
agro.s4.sugar.body.dst: Azúcar y cultivos comerciales relacionados como materias primas de procesamiento centrales dentro del modelo Ag Park.

agro.s4.protein.body.src: Beef protein plus teak, beans and fruit horticulture in buffer spaces where land permits.
agro.s4.protein.body.dst: Proteína de vacuno más horticultura de teca, frijoles y frutas en espacios de amortiguamiento donde el terreno lo permita.

agro.s5.serenje.body.src: Operations oversee the Serenje plantation platform with specialties in agronomy, crop harvesting, disease control, seed/fertilizer/input management, equipment procurement, works contracting and irrigation project oversight.
agro.s5.serenje.body.dst: Las operaciones supervisan la plataforma de plantaciones Serenje con especialidades en agronomía, cosecha de cultivos, control de enfermedades, manejo de semillas/fertilizantes/insumos, adquisición de equipos, contratación de obras y supervisión de proyectos de riego.

agro.s5.parks.body.src: Ag Parks consolidate produce and add value through processing. As the first Ag Park team is constituted, capacity is expected to roughly double, supported by Rising Stars projects that attract and retain talent.
agro.s5.parks.body.dst: Los Ag Parks consolidan productos y agregan valor a través del procesamiento. A medida que se constituya el primer equipo de Ag Park, se espera que la capacidad se duplique aproximadamente, con el apoyo de proyectos Rising Stars que atraen y retienen talento.

agro.s6.lede.src: People are Lake Agro’s biggest company asset. Farming does not exist without human capital and equity. About 60 roles oversee Serenje plantation and Tanzania regional offices, scaling as Ag Park teams form.
agro.s6.lede.dst: Las personas son el mayor activo empresarial de Lake Agro. La agricultura no existe sin capital humano y equidad. Alrededor de 60 puestos supervisan la plantación de Serenje y las oficinas regionales Tanzania, ampliando a medida que se forman los equipos de Ag Park.

agro.s6.inputs.d.dst: Manejo de semillas, fertilizantes e insumos.

agro.s7.lede.dst: Programas y promesas de los compromisos de Lake Agro: contenido local, apoyo a los productores, salud, capacitación y estándares E/S.

agro.s7.health.1.dst: Apoyar las instalaciones de los centros de salud en las plantaciones y parques agrícolas.

agro.s7.health.5.src: Specialist snake and arachnid treatment capacity
agro.s7.health.5.dst: Capacidad de tratamiento especializado de serpientes y arácnidos.

agro.s7.train.1.dst: Centros vocacionales para agricultores, trabajadores y especialistas

agro.s7.csr.body.src: Lake Group considers contribution to the community a high priority. We create local labour, train employees and improve professional know-how across operations.
agro.s7.csr.body.dst: Lake Group considera que la contribución a la comunidad es una alta prioridad. Creamos mano de obra local, capacitamos empleados y mejoramos el conocimiento profesional en todas las operaciones.

agro.s7.es.body.src: Projects follow high E/S standards, including IFC Performance Standards for new CAPEX. No people are harmed, resettled or lose land or property as a result of our activities. Dedicated teams ensure compliance on each project.
agro.s7.es.body.dst: Los proyectos siguen altos estándares ambientales y sociales, incluidos los estándares de desempeño de la IFC para nuevos CAPEX. Ninguna persona resulta perjudicada, reasentada o pierde tierras o propiedades como resultado de nuestras actividades. Equipos dedicados garantizan el cumplimiento en cada proyecto.

agro.s8.p1.src: All departments (IT, legal counsel, auditing and human resources) are streamlined to help achieve future strategies. A talent pool of human resources allows Lake Agro to operate and maintain project sustainability financially, socially and on a production basis.
agro.s8.p1.dst: Todos los departamentos (TI, asesoría jurídica, auditoría y recursos humanos) están optimizados para ayudar a lograr estrategias futuras. Un grupo de talentos de recursos humanos permite a Lake Agro operar y mantener la sostenibilidad del proyecto financiera, social y productivamente.

agro.s8.p2.src: Leadership technical know-how entrenches a deep understanding of how to plan, run and execute plantations - and how to secure or improve them over time.
agro.s8.p2.dst: El conocimiento técnico del liderazgo afianza una profunda comprensión de cómo planificar, administrar y ejecutar plantaciones, y cómo asegurarlas o mejorarlas con el tiempo.

atl.hero.lede.src: Aluminium Trailers Ltd - Tanzania’s aluminium fuel tanker and custom trailer manufacturer. Your trailer partner.
atl.hero.lede.dst: Aluminium Trailers Ltd: fabricante de remolques personalizados y camiones cisterna de combustible de aluminio de Tanzania. Tu compañero de remolque.

atl.s1.lede.src: ATL Limited (Aluminum Trailers Ltd), established in 2019, is the only manufacturer of high-quality aluminum trailers in Tanzania. We specialize in innovative, durable fuel transportation solutions for East and Central Africa.
atl.s1.lede.dst: ATL Limited (Aluminum Trailers Ltd), establecida en 2019, es el único fabricante de remolques de aluminio de alta calidad en Tanzania. Nos especializamos en soluciones innovadoras y duraderas de transporte de combustible para East y Central Africa.

atl.s1.p2.src: With a focus on excellence, ATL has earned a reputation as a reliable name in trailer manufacturing, delivering tankers that consistently meet and surpass customer expectations. Our strategy expands the range into premium customized trailers across the region.
atl.s1.p2.dst: Con un enfoque en la excelencia, ATL se ha ganado la reputación de ser un nombre confiable en la fabricación de remolques, entregando camiones cisterna que consistentemente cumplen y superan las expectativas de los clientes. Nuestra estrategia amplía la gama a remolques personalizados de primera calidad en toda la región.

atl.s1.check1.src: Only aluminium trailer manufacturer in Tanzania
atl.s1.check1.dst: Único fabricante de remolques de aluminio en Tanzania

atl.s1.check2.src: Fuel tankers engineered for African operating conditions
atl.s1.check2.dst: Camiones cisterna de combustible diseñados para las condiciones operativas africanas

atl.s1.check3.src: Custom builds with technical support and warranty
atl.s1.check3.dst: Construcciones personalizadas con soporte técnico y garantía.

atl.s1.check4.src: Facility at Kipawa, Nyerere Road (opp. JNIA Terminal 3)
atl.s1.check4.dst: Instalaciones en Kipawa, Nyerere Road (frente a la Terminal 3 de JNIA)

atl.s2.mission.body.src: To design and manufacture the highest quality trailers by fostering a culture of integrity, excellence, and continuous improvement.
atl.s2.mission.body.dst: Diseñar y fabricar remolques de la más alta calidad fomentando una cultura de integridad, excelencia y mejora continua.

atl.s2.vision.body.src: To become the leading trailer manufacturer in East and Central Africa, providing sustainable solutions focused on safety, innovation and customization.
atl.s2.vision.body.dst: Convertirnos en el fabricante de remolques líder en Oriente y Central Africa, brindando soluciones sustentables enfocadas en seguridad, innovación y personalización.

atl.val.integrity.d.src: Honesty, transparency and accountability. We deliver on promises and maintain a strong moral compass.
atl.val.integrity.d.dst: Honestidad, transparencia y responsabilidad. Cumplimos nuestras promesas y mantenemos una sólida brújula moral.

atl.val.people.d.src: Employees are our greatest asset - safety, inclusion, professional development and a positive culture.
atl.val.people.d.dst: Los empleados son nuestro mayor activo: seguridad, inclusión, desarrollo profesional y una cultura positiva.

atl.val.sust.d.src: Lower impact materials and processes; products that support greener transport requirements.
atl.val.sust.d.dst: Materiales y procesos de menor impacto; productos que respaldan requisitos de transporte más ecológicos.

atl.val.cust.d.src: Long-term partners built on trust, value, quality and reliability - not one-off sales.
atl.val.cust.d.dst: Socios a largo plazo basados ​​en la confianza, el valor, la calidad y la confiabilidad, no en ventas únicas.

atl.s3.savings.4.src: Long-term savings on maintenance and repairs
atl.s3.savings.4.dst: Ahorros a largo plazo en mantenimiento y reparaciones

atl.s4.non.body.src: Aluminum is non-reactive with most fuels, helping prevent contamination - especially important for sensitive fuels including aviation fuel.
atl.s4.non.body.dst: El aluminio no reacciona con la mayoría de los combustibles, lo que ayuda a prevenir la contaminación, algo especialmente importante para los combustibles sensibles, incluido el combustible de aviación.

atl.s4.corr.body.src: Naturally resists rust in harsh weather and moisture, reducing maintenance and prolonging tanker life.
atl.s4.corr.body.dst: Resiste naturalmente la oxidación en condiciones climáticas adversas y humedad, lo que reduce el mantenimiento y prolonga la vida útil del camión cisterna.

atl.s4.fuel.body.src: Lower tare weight means more legal payload and less energy to haul the tanker.
atl.s4.fuel.body.dst: Una tara más baja significa más carga útil legal y menos energía para transportar el camión cisterna.

atl.s4.str.body.src: High strength-to-weight ratio for transport stresses, with impact absorption that supports operational safety.
atl.s4.str.body.dst: Alta relación resistencia-peso para las tensiones de transporte, con absorción de impactos que respalda la seguridad operativa.

atl.s4.env.body.src: Highly recyclable aluminium with lower recycling energy versus primary production - aligned with strict fuel-transport standards.
atl.s4.env.body.dst: Aluminio altamente reciclable con menor energía de reciclaje en comparación con la producción primaria, alineado con estrictos estándares de transporte de combustible.

atl.s4.custom.body.src: Expanding beyond fuel tankers into premium customized trailers for regional logistics needs.
atl.s4.custom.body.dst: Expandirnos más allá de los camiones cisterna de combustible hacia remolques personalizados de primera calidad para las necesidades de logística regional.

atl.s5.title.dst: Cisternas y remolques personalizados para África

atl.s5.lede.src: Discover our range of high-quality aluminum fuel tankers designed for safety, durability, and efficiency. Each model is built to meet industry standards and tailored to your specific needs.
atl.s5.lede.dst: Descubra nuestra gama de camiones cisterna de combustible de aluminio de alta calidad diseñados para ofrecer seguridad, durabilidad y eficiencia. Cada modelo está construido para cumplir con los estándares de la industria y adaptado a sus necesidades específicas.

atl.s5.tankers.body.src: High-quality aluminum fuel tankers designed for safety, durability and efficiency on African routes.
atl.s5.tankers.body.dst: Buques cisterna de combustible de aluminio de alta calidad diseñados para ofrecer seguridad, durabilidad y eficiencia en las rutas africanas.

atl.s5.custom.body.src: Tailored trailer configurations to match payload, coupling and operating requirements.
atl.s5.custom.body.dst: Configuraciones de remolque personalizadas para cumplir con los requisitos de carga útil, acoplamiento y operación.

atl.s5.support.body.src: Technical support, warranty coverage and maintenance partnership after delivery.
atl.s5.support.body.dst: Soporte técnico, cobertura de garantía y asociación de mantenimiento después de la entrega.

atl.s6.lede.src: At ATL, we pride ourselves on trailers that deliver unmatched performance, durability, and value. Hear from the people who rely on our aluminum trailers every day.
atl.s6.lede.dst: En ATL, nos enorgullecemos de los remolques que ofrecen rendimiento, durabilidad y valor inigualables. Escuche a las personas que confían en nuestros remolques de aluminio todos los días.

atl.s6.q1.src: "Thank you, Aluminum Trailers Limited. Looking forward for more transformation of our trailers with you. As you won't find a better customer servicing of high quality manufacturing anywhere else in East Africa, it just allows us to rely on you comfortably."
atl.s6.q1.dst: "Gracias, Aluminium Trailers Limited. Esperamos una mayor transformación de nuestros remolques con usted. Como no encontrará un mejor servicio al cliente de fabricación de alta calidad en ningún otro lugar de East Africa, esto nos permite confiar en usted cómodamente".

atl.s6.q2.src: "From fabrication to manufacturing quality - the effective best manufacturing tanker company I have dealt with. Higher volumes loaded, many trips in a short time. The overall merits of the trailer are amazing."
atl.s6.q2.dst: "Desde la fabricación hasta la calidad de fabricación: la mejor empresa de fabricación de camiones cisterna con la que he tratado. Mayores volúmenes cargados, muchos viajes en poco tiempo. Las ventajas generales del remolque son sorprendentes".

atl.s7.lede.src: ATL works with leading regional financial and commercial partners supporting fleet and manufacturing growth.
atl.s7.lede.dst: ATL trabaja con socios financieros y comerciales regionales líderes que respaldan el crecimiento de la flota y la fabricación.

leadership.156.dst: Director general de Lake Energies, la división de energía de Lake Group que abarca petróleo, LPG, lubricantes y servicios de aviación en toda la presencia regional del Grupo.

leadership.157.src: As Managing Director of Lake Energies, Biji Alapat leads the Group’s energy division - the family of operating companies that includes Lake Oil, Lake Gas, Lake Lubes and Lake Aviation.
leadership.157.dst: Como Director General de Lake Energies, Biji Alapat dirige la división de energía del Grupo, la familia de empresas operativas que incluye a Lake Oil, Lake Gas, Lake Lubes y Lake Aviation.

leadership.158.src: Lake Energies sits at the core of Lake Group’s downstream energy platform: retail and bulk petroleum distribution, LPG bottling and storage, lubricant blending, and aviation fuel services supporting customers across East and Central Africa.
leadership.158.dst: Lake Energies se encuentra en el centro de la plataforma de energía downstream de Lake Group: distribución minorista y a granel de petróleo, embotellado y almacenamiento de LPG, mezcla de lubricantes y servicios de combustible de aviación que respaldan a los clientes en todo el Este y Central Africa.

leadership.159.src: Working from the Group’s Dar es Salaam headquarters, the Lake Energies mandate aligns commercial and operational priorities across these energy units with Lake Group’s wider logistics and industrial network.
leadership.159.dst: Trabajando desde la sede Dar es Salaam del Grupo, el mandato de Lake Energies alinea las prioridades comerciales y operativas en estas unidades de energía con la red logística e industrial más amplia de Lake Group.
